proposed_comments.title: Refresh immersive color policy before reapplying app mode
proposed_comments.body: Refresh() re-queries ShouldAppsUseDarkMode without refreshing uxtheme's cached immersive-color policy, so an AppsUseLightTheme change can leave the old value in use. Load ordinal 104, RefreshImmersiveColorPolicyState, and call it before reapplying SetPreferredAppMode.

proposed_comments.title: Listen for app-theme changes
proposed_comments.body: The tray menu dark-mode decision follows the app theme, but the runner only registers a system-theme handler. Register the refresh handler for app-theme changes as well so menu mode updates when AppsUseLightTheme changes without a SystemUsesLightTheme change.

proposed_comments.title: Respect high-contrast menu colors
proposed_comments.body: The fixed dark brush overrides Windows high-contrast menu colors. Check SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST and skip custom menu background brushes when HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON is set.

proposed_comments.title: Initialize dark-mode ordinals before creating the tray window
proposed_comments.body: SetPreferredAppMode should be initialized before the tray window is created, matching the referenced ZoomIt sequence. Move DarkMode::Initialize() before RegisterClass/CreateWindowW.
